title: Rasan Khol Do
body:
Aye Momino, Ye Qayamat Ki Daastan Sunlo,
Yateem Bacchi Ki Gurbat Ki Ye Fuganh Sunlo,
Tamache Durre, Laieeno Ki Ghudkiya Lekar,
Jo Bacchi Mar Gai Zindan-E-Sham Me Ja Kar,
Wo Rahe Sham Me, Yu Bain Karti Jati Thi,
Tadap Tadap Ke Phuphi Se Ye Kehti Jati Thi,
Hey Tadap Tadap Ke Phuphi Se Ye Kehti Jati Thi.
Rasan Khol Do. 4
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Hai Dhushwar Saanso Ka Lena Mera,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Hai Dhushwar Saanso Ka Lena Mera,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(1) Aaziyat Se Itni Main Mar Jaungi,
Main Sugra Se Milne Ko Ghar Jaungi,
Na Qasim Na Akbar Na Asgar Rahe,
Main Fariyad Karne Kidhar Jaungi,
Ye Rudade Gham Meri Sun Lo Zara.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(2) Ye Zalim Ko Ja Ke Bata Do Phuphi,
Hai Fariyad Karti Meri Kamsini,
Na Aise Kisika Bandha Hai Gala,
Main Jis Tarah Rassi Me Bandhi Gai.
Mai Kis Kisse Aakhir Krugi Gila,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(3) Meri Umr Dekho Aur Kaide Sitam,
Kahi Raste Me Na Mar Jaye Hum,
Meri Saans Ruk Ruk Ke Chalne Lagi,
Mere Khushk Hotho Aa Pahucha Dum,
Rasan Me Hai Halkum Mera Daba,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(4) Musibat Ki Har Simt Yalghar Hai,
Mera Saans Lena Bhi Dushwar Hai,
Bachye To Kaise Bachye Mujhe,
Mera Bhai Sajjad Bimar Hai,
Gala Chill Gaya Hai Rasan Se Mera,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(5) Gala Naazni Aur Uspe Rasan,
De Kis Awaz Ye Km Sukhan,
Labo Se Sada Tak Nikalti Nahi,
Banega Kabi Mera Kurta Kafan,
Sakina Pe Aisa Sitam Ho Gya.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(6) Phuphi Laut Kar Ab Madine Chalo,
Waha Chalk E Sugra Se Itna Kaho,
Na Aayega Akbar Tera Lautkar,
Khuda Ke Liye Aasra Todh Do,
Bs Itni Si Zehmat Uthalo Zara.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(7) Phuphi Maine Socha Na Tha Is Qadar,
Ki Rona Padega Mujhe Umr Bhar,
Watan Chodh Kar Jab Se Aai Hu Main,
Musibat Aaziyat Ghutan Aur Safar,
Yhi Meri Taqdeer Me Hai Likha.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(8) Phuphi Jaan Jab Mujhko Maut Aayegi,
Yakeei Hai Sugra Bhi Ghabrayegi,
Na Dena Use Maut Ki Tum Khabar,
Sunegi To Khud Hi Wo Mar Jayegi,
Ye Sunte Hi Zainab Ko Ghash Aa Gya,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(9) Ye Ehsaas Bacchi Ke Kehte Rahe,
Sitam Isqadar Mujhpe Kaise Hue,
Tha Begoro Maqtal Me Baba Mera,
Lipat Kar Na Ro Payee Mai Lash Se,
Khuda Jane Baba Kaha Hai Mera.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(10) Mai Pusht-E-Shuturg Pe Bhi Bandhi Gai,
Chacha Ko Mai Rokar Bulati Rahi,
Na Meri Fogan Koi Bhi Sun Saka,
Main Sadme Yahi Sab Uthati Rahi,
Hai Toofan-E-Gham Mujhpe Toota Hua.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(11) Bandhe Hath Bhai Ke Mere Bandhe,
Ye Gham Dar Badar Haye Phirte Rahe,
Sare Shah Naize Se Rota Raha,
Aur Hum Sir Jhuka Kar Hi Chalte Rahe,
Nabi Ki Nawasi Pe Aisi Jafa,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(12) Mujhe Aise Naaqe Pe Bandha Gaya,
Khuli Pusht Thi Aur Kajawa Na Tha,
Mujhe Zakham Pe Zakham Lagte Rahe,
Hai Zakhmo Se Challni Ye Sina Mera,
Phuphi Jaan Mera Haal Dekho Zara.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(13) Andhera Phuphi Qaid Khane Me Hai,
Aur Ummeed Yasrab Jo Jane Me Hai,
Mujhe Maut Gar Aai Zindan Me,
Ye Gham Mujhtaib Ab Uthane Me Hai,
Waha Bekafan Hoga Laasha Mera.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(14) Main Rooi To Naake Bilakne Lage,
Ye Aapas Ye Waye Ye Kehne Lage,
Qadam Dheere Dheere Sab Apne Rakho,
Ye Ahl-E-Haram Sab Tadapne Lage,
Ajab Sham Walo Ne Ki Hai Jafa.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(15) Watan Me Main Sugra Ko Chodh Aai Hu,
Mai Dil Us Mariza Ka Todh Aai Hu,
Na Jane Madine Main Kab Jaugi,
Abhi Tak Main Khul Kar Na Roo Pai Hu,
Phata Jar Aha Hai Kaleja Mera.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(16) Kahi Bhaiyo Ke Hai Lashe Pade,
Kahi Pe Hai Aun Or Mohammad Gire,
Yahi Sochti Reh Gai Main Phuphi,
Yaha Aa Hum Kyu Sataye Gaye,
Jise Dekho Wo Bekafan Tha Pada.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(17) Watan Mujhko Jane Ka Armaan Hai,
Bahen Meri Sugra Pareshan Hai,
Khuda Ke Liye Mujhko Ghar Le Chalo,
Madina Mera Haye Sunsan Hai,
Kahi Wo Tadapti Na Ho Gham Zada,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(18) Mere Bhai Abid Se Keh Dijiye,
Agar Maut Aaye Tere Samne,
To Hai Ek Choti Si Ye Eltija,
Kafan Mere Kurte Ka Dena Mujhe,
Na Ho Bekafan Haye Lasha Mera.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
(19) Adeeb Uski Turbat Pe Nauha Padho,
Sakina Ki Ghurbat Ka Matam Karo,
Yateemi Aasiri Tamache Ghutan,
Shabab Itna Majboor Koi Na Ho.
Ye Kehte Hue Mar Gai Ghamzada.
Rasan Khol Do. -2
Phuphi Se Sakina Ne Rokar Kaha,
Rasan Khol Do. -2
